evidence: Portable mask_tone_v3 hue on software Vulkan / Phase AA

contract.higherPrecisionReference: IEEE binary64 standard signed sRGB transfer with exponent 1/2.4; ULP counts compared against nearest binary32. Extended-F32 rows are stratified and deliberately include HDR bins near Float.max.
contract.iosurfaceGate: Every native and half Float32 component and the whole 2400 sRGB8 raster compared to native on both photographs.
contract.authority: v2 named frozen scalar coverage in stock C ABI render slots. Original CI computes matching captured coverage. Two independent masks or analytic/radial shader geometry are outside the measured hue change.

scope.adapters: Only active wgpu Backend::Vulkan with DeviceType::Cpu receives specialization. No device-name or OS selection. Evidence covers llvmpipe, Mesa 22.3.6/LLVM15.0.6 on Linux arm64. App Metal hardware keeps the original transfer.
scope.scalar: Positive nonlinear magnitudes use sqrt(sqrt(a)) times cbrt(sqrt(a)), with one Newton iteration for the cubic root. Sign, toe, NaN/Inf routing and hue angles are preserved. For 0.0031308<a<=Float.max all sqrt, cube-root estimate, squared estimate and correction stay normal and representable. The independent full extended input test below measures the transfer itself, not a promise of absolute 2e-6 at arbitrary HDR magnitudes.
scope.cpu: Existing C++ arithmetic with -ffp-contract=off and the Rust-pinned libm 0.2.16 powf path. The CPU received no hue arithmetic change. All 32 candidate CPU outputs compared byte-for-byte with both previous macOS and arm64 Linux CPU outputs.

diagnosticCheckpoints.method: Independent public C ABI shader variants returned one internal value at a time. This identifies the divergence; intact production RAW output is measured separately.
diagnosticCheckpoints.fmaObservation: 16 direct-FMA, phase or intrinsic-spelling variants left the original full output of this exposed pixel unchanged.

transferGrid.additionalF32: Every binary32 exponent 0..254 with both signs, low and high mantissas, seeded random mantissas and values around transfer/other cutoffs. Includes Float.max and signed zero.

sourceAndReproduction.differentialHarness: portable-local-mask-tone-sources.tar.gz preserves the frozen-record producer, C ABI replay executable source, generated shader and input recipe files. Store separately measured stock, candidate and independently built runtime receipts with each sample.
